notes: These are not winners yet and are not selected from generic category trend lists.
Amazon candidates require retail price, competition, PPC, FBA, IP, compliance, and landed-cost validation.
Autivara will test one coherent seven-product category before considering additional category expansion.

amazonCandidates.problem: Travelers cannot locate a lost suitcase and still need a TSA-compliant physical lock.
amazonCandidates.product: TSA combination luggage lock with built-in Find My-compatible tracker
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Bundle lock, replaceable battery, luggage tag, setup guide, and travel recovery card.
amazonCandidates.risk: Verify Apple Find My authorization, TSA compliance, battery shipping, and patent status.

amazonCandidates.problem: Water leaks cause expensive damage before homeowners notice them.
amazonCandidates.product: IP66 Tuya Zigbee water-leak sensor with phone alerts
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Sell as a three- or five-room prevention kit with placement labels and setup guide.
amazonCandidates.risk: Confirm hub requirements, app longevity, FCC documentation, battery life, and alert reliability.

amazonCandidates.problem: Reading difficulty and language barriers make printed material inaccessible.
amazonCandidates.product: Wi-Fi AI scanner pen with text-to-speech and 112-language translation
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Focus the offer on travel, ESL learning, and reading assistance with a protective case and tutorials.
amazonCandidates.risk: Do not make medical claims; verify offline functions, privacy, translation quality, and software support.

amazonCandidates.problem: Steam cleaning multiple household surfaces requires several tools.
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Create task-specific attachment bundles and visual cleaning protocols.
amazonCandidates.risk: High opening MOQ; validate ETL/UL-equivalent electrical and burn-safety compliance before sampling.

amazonCandidates.problem: Bathroom waste bins require hand contact and expose liners.
amazonCandidates.product: Compact motion-sensor touchless bathroom trash can
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Improve liner retention, splash resistance, narrow-space fit, and include fitted liners.
amazonCandidates.risk: Bulky dimensional freight could erase the apparent price advantage.

amazonCandidates.problem: People worry about hidden cameras in hotels and short-term rentals.
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Bundle a privacy inspection card, travel case, and verified detection-distance specifications.
amazonCandidates.risk: Cheap optical-only detectors may underperform; hands-on efficacy testing is mandatory.

amazonCandidates.problem: Insect bites remain itchy and topical products are inconvenient while traveling.
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Pair with a travel case and clear temperature/treatment controls.
amazonCandidates.risk: Medical-device classification, burn risk, claims, and safety documentation require review.

amazonCandidates.problem: Opening wine bottles is difficult for users with limited grip strength.
amazonCandidates.product: Private-label cordless electric wine opener gift set
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Premium gift packaging, foil cutter, date stopper, and accessibility-led positioning.
amazonCandidates.risk: Mature category; enter only if the bundle and keyword gap survive Amazon validation.

amazonCandidates.problem: Food waste smells and accumulates before disposal or outdoor composting.
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Odor-filter subscription, quieter cycle, countertop footprint comparison, and waste-reduction education.
amazonCandidates.risk: High return and warranty exposure; verify certifications, filter supply, cycle claims, freight, and patents.

amazonCandidates.problem: Exterior windows are difficult or unsafe to clean from inside apartments.
amazonCandidates.differentiation: Safety-tether kit, glass compatibility guide, replacement pads, and verified edge detection.
amazonCandidates.risk: Product-liability, fall risk, certification, returns, and dimensional economics require strict testing.
